question: Has Chilli Crunch Avocado Oil been acquired by or merged with another company? Who owns Chilli Crunch Avocado Oil now?
markdown:
If you are referring to the**

Chilli Crunch with Avocado Oil

**product released by the UK brand **Woolf's Kitchen**, it has not been acquired by or merged with another company. Instead, it is an ingredient collaboration with fellow female-founded brand **Omega Pressery**, which supplies the avocado oil. Woolf's Kitchen remains independently owned by its founder. [](https://thewoolfskitchen.com/products/chilli-crunch-with-avocado-oil)

_(Note: If you were instead thinking of the high-profile trademark history of the broader "Chili/Chile Crunch" name, celebrity chef David Chang’s company **Momofuku** acquired the spelling "Chile Crunch" via a 2023 legal settlement with Denver-based Chile Colonial, LLC, but does not own specific avocado-oil variants)._

-   **Product:**

Chilli Crunch with Avocado Oil

-   **Partnership Type:** Collaborative product launch (not an acquisition or merger)

-   **Collaborator:** Omega Pressery (sources avocado oil from smallholder farms in East Africa)

-   **Current Owner:** Woolf's Kitchen

If you meant a **different brand** that makes a chili crunch using avocado oil (such as _Crispy Ho_ or _By Bon_), please share the **brand name** so I can give you the exact ownership details! [](https://www.bybon.au/products/chilli-crunch-avocado-oil)
